boardIntro: Compare model outputs against realised data and a volatility-adjusted random walk. Each output is locked before the next close.
awaitingBody: No live observations have been published. Scores, ranks and intervals appear only after verifiable outputs and outcomes exist.
minimumRank: Numeric ranks require at least 60 paired observations across 75% of enabled indicators.
minimumPI: Predictability labels require at least 30 paired observations. Missing evidence stays visible.
matrixIntro: 90-observation CRPS skill relative to the volatility-adjusted random walk. Higher is better.
matrixCaption: Each cell shows paired CRPS skill. No cell is scored before 10 shared observations.
outputsIntro: Median and 80% interval, attributed to each entrant. One session ahead.
scorecardEmpty: A scorecard becomes available after the first locked outputs can be evaluated.
modelsIntro: A common input. The same deadline. An honest baseline in every table.
modelNote: Positive skill means lower paired CRPS than the reference. The interval is a 95% block-bootstrap confidence interval. Direction hit is a scoring statistic on called observations.
smallWindowNote: 7d has fewer than the required 10 observations per cell. Scores and tiers remain unavailable; 30d never receives numeric ranks.
indicatorsIntro: The Predictability Index evaluates the ensemble against the reference on the same observations, using the 90-observation window.
posthoc: Selected after observing the results; this is descriptive only.
returnOnly: Only transformed changes are displayed; underlying levels are withheld.
ledgerIntro: Canonical files, public commit references and append-only corrections make the published numbers inspectable.
verifyStep: Download the canonical forecast file, compute its SHA-256 and compare it with the ledger hash and referenced commit. Git author timestamps alone do not prove publication time.
statusIntro: Missing data and failed runs remain part of the record.
contactPending: Public contact has not been configured; launch is blocked.
aboutIntro: TSFM Live relays model outputs and evaluates them against subsequently observed data. It is a free, public research benchmark.
privacy: No accounts, cookies, advertising or analytics. Theme and language preferences are stored only on your device.
apiIntro: Generated JSON views come from the same ledger as this site. No key is required. Every document includes its schema version, generation time and licence.
apiOriginPending: A public origin is not configured. The example uses the local preview.
translationStale: The Korean methodology may be older than the English source.
disclaimer: TSFM Live publishes the raw outputs of publicly available time-series models and scores them against realised data for research and benchmarking purposes only. Nothing on this site is investment advice, a recommendation, or an offer to buy or sell any financial instrument. The operators do not trade on these outputs and accept no liability for decisions made using this site. Model outputs are frequently no better than a random walk; see the Methodology and Indicators pages.
intervalHistoryNote: Last 60 forecast sessions. The band is the selected entrant’s 80% interval; dots show realised values in transformed units.
forecastChartLabel: Observed values and model medians with 80% intervals
forecastModelLegend: Model medians and 80% intervals; select a model to highlight it
forecastTodayNote: Today shows the latest available daily observation; its date may be earlier than today.
forecastSevenNote: Actual observations within 7 calendar days ending on the latest observed date. Missing days are not filled.
forecastSameSession: Numbers identify models forecasting the same session. Select a model to highlight its interval.
forecastExpiredNote: This forecast session has ended. These are archived model outputs, not a new upcoming forecast.
forecastDisabledNote: This indicator is currently disabled. Details and data-source availability are recorded on its indicator page.
forecastSessionNote: One session ahead follows each indicator’s calendar, including holidays. Only published values appear here.
